messages:
Carmen: All-hands in 25. Quick note — slide order changed (roadmap moved up), and PTX demo is now at 11:15. Also switching primary stream relay to rtpl-2. Can someone cover live captions + a local ISO record? :eyes:
Kevin: I can run captions. Live captions OK? Or do you want a post-run transcript?
Carmen: Live captions please. If captions drop, keep the ISO recording of the presenter.
Leena: I'll take the local recording. OBS on the stage laptop has been jittery — planning to run an ffmpeg fallback. Posting the command now.
Leena: Command I'll run:
```bash
ffmpeg -y -f alsa -i hw:0 -f x11grab -s 1920x1080 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 23 allhands_iso.mkv
```
Tom: @Leena +1 on the ISO. Can you also open a backup RTMP stream to twitch-relay? I want an alternate in case rtpl-2 spikes.
stream-bot: relay switch to rtpl-2 scheduled at 11:08 — monitoring throughput and packet loss.
Kevin: Captioning tool (Otter instance) linked to the deck. If we see latency >2s I'll switch to local SRT captions.
Carmen: Logistics for Q&A: Anna will take live questions after the roadmap segment. Please drop priority Qs in #all-hands-qa so we can surface them.
Anna (CEO): I'll join for Q&A. If the room gets noisy, toss questions into Slack and we'll triage.
Leena: Local recording started. I'll upload to the shared bucket after the meeting: /shared/allhands/31333_iso/ — I'll trim boilerplate and annotate timestamps.
Tom: Heads-up: slide deck v2 has a last-minute tweak — @Design-Bot can you confirm slide 7's graph is legible at 1280 width?
Design-Bot: New deck uploaded: allhands_v2_final.pdf (sha256: abc123def456). Thumbnail generation complete.
Kevin: Captions live and looking stable from my side. Monitoring latency and edit buffer.
Carmen: Great. Keep comms terse during live. If anything degrades, ping me and @ops immediately. See you in 20. :rocket:
